//REGION Grymforge lift: line on arrival after the level swap (the ride is behind the loading screen)
PROC
PROC_GLO_LevelSwap_LeavingFromTo(_, "ReadyCheck_ToSCLFromUnderdark")
THEN
DB_ALFSV_LiftArrival("SCL_Main_A");

PROC
PROC_GLO_LevelSwap_LeavingFromTo(_, "ReadyCheck_ToWLDFromSCL")
THEN
DB_ALFSV_LiftArrival("WLD_Main_A");

IF
LevelGameplayStarted(_Level, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_LiftArrival(_Level)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_LiftArrival(_Level);
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Request("GrymforgeLift");

//END_REGION

//REGION Place lines: event -> request -> first free moment within the wait window

IF
EnteredTrigger(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Trigger)
AND
DB_ALFSV_PlaceTrigger(_Trigger, _Key)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Request(_Key);

IF
FlagSet(_Flag, NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_PlaceFlag(_Flag, _Key)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Request(_Key);

IF
LevelGameplayStarted(_Level, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_PlaceLevel(_Level, _Key)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Request(_Key);

// Alfira is a companion, in the active party, and has not said this line yet
QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Place_Wanted((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
AND
DB_Players(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Place(_Key, _)
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_PlaceDone(_Key)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Request((STRING)_Key)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_Place_Wanted(_Key)
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_PlacePending(_Key, _)
THEN
DB_ALFSV_PlacePending(_Key, 12);
PROC_ALFSV_AD_Try();

//END_REGION

//REGION One AD at a time: requested -> started (done) or failed (retry on the next tick)

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_AD_Free()
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_AD_Requested(_, _)
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_AD_Playing(_)
AND
QRY_SpeakerIsAvailable(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_AD_Try()
AND
DB_ALFSV_PlacePending(_Key, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Place(_Key, _Dialog)
AND
DB_Players(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_AD_Free()
THEN
DB_ALFSV_AD_Requested(_Dialog, _Key);
PROC_ALFSV_AD_SetMood();
PROC_TryStartAD(_Dialog, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_AD_Try()
AND
DB_ALFSV_PlacePending(_, _)
THEN
TimerCancel("ALFSV_World_Tick");
TimerLaunch("ALFSV_World_Tick", 5000);

IF
AutomatedDialogStarted(_Dialog, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_AD_Requested(_Dialog, _Key)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_AD_Requested(_Dialog, _Key);
DB_ALFSV_AD_Playing(_Dialog);
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Done(_Key);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Done((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Place(_Key, _)
THEN
DB_ALFSV_PlaceDone(_Key);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Done((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_PlacePending(_Key, _N)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_PlacePending(_Key, _N);

IF
AutomatedDialogEnded(_Dialog, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_AD_Playing(_Dialog)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_AD_Playing(_Dialog);
PROC_ALFSV_AD_Try();

// Tick: forget a request that did not start, age the pending lines, try again
IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_World_Tick")
AND
DB_ALFSV_AD_Requested(_Dialog, _Key)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_AD_Requested(_Dialog, _Key);

IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_World_Tick")
AND
DB_ALFSV_PlacePending(_Key, _N)
AND
IntegerSubtract(_N, 1, _Left)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_PlacePending(_Key, _N);
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Age(_Key, _Left);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Age((STRING)_Key, (INTEGER)_Left)
AND
_Left > 0
THEN
DB_ALFSV_PlacePending(_Key, _Left);

IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_World_Tick")
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_AD_Try();

// A dialog that ends without AutomatedDialogEnded (level change) must not block the next ones
IF
LevelGameplayStarted(_, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_AD_Playing(_Dialog)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_AD_Playing(_Dialog);

//END_REGION

//REGION Mood flags on Alfira for the AD roots (union over all avatars): romance > spark > cold > normal

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_AD_SetMood()
THEN
ClearFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_AD_Romance_e0fd8c86-4bf4-5934-a8fc-12c77c9c8123, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);
ClearFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_AD_Spark_98a44cca-ccc3-50c0-b440-5bc5eccca40f, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);
ClearFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_AD_NotchCity_4f2662d3-7635-505b-aaaa-83e744b2bfe6, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);
ClearFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_AD_Cold_efbde2e8-21fb-5734-a20b-5a07e302eb88, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);
ClearFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_AD_Warm_e756cb13-7fe7-5bbd-b49c-0a78d4b2beed, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_AD_SetMood()
AND
DB_Avatars(_Avatar)
AND
GetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Romance_Started_1fa672d6-9d12-5018-9492-6af2b7ed484b, _Avatar, 1)
THEN
SetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_AD_Romance_e0fd8c86-4bf4-5934-a8fc-12c77c9c8123, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_AD_SetMood()
AND
DB_Avatars(_Avatar)
AND
GetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Romance_Spark_1d9755cb-3197-575f-8dd2-bc6776e3c0cd, _Avatar, 1)
THEN
SetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_AD_Spark_98a44cca-ccc3-50c0-b440-5bc5eccca40f, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_AD_SetMood()
AND
DB_Avatars(_Avatar)
AND
GetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Romance_Started_1fa672d6-9d12-5018-9492-6af2b7ed484b, _Avatar, 1)
THEN
SetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_AD_Spark_98a44cca-ccc3-50c0-b440-5bc5eccca40f, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_AD_SetMood()
AND
DB_Avatars(_Avatar)
AND
GetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Notch_City_8240aca8-7d20-56ff-ac24-902604e91bb8, _Avatar, 1)
THEN
SetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_AD_NotchCity_4f2662d3-7635-505b-aaaa-83e744b2bfe6, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_AD_SetMood()
AND
DB_Avatars(_Avatar)
AND
DB_ApprovalRating(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Avatar, _Value)
AND
_Value < 0
THEN
SetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_AD_Cold_efbde2e8-21fb-5734-a20b-5a07e302eb88, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_AD_SetMood()
AND
DB_Avatars(_Avatar)
AND
DB_ApprovalRating(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Avatar, _Value)
AND
_Value >= 40
THEN
SetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_AD_Warm_e756cb13-7fe7-5bbd-b49c-0a78d4b2beed, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);

//END_REGION

//REGION Crèche Y'llek funicular: a 3-line mini-scene (start / midway / top)
PROC
PROC_CRE_Dungeon_ElevatorMove((LEVELTEMPLATE)S_LTN_PLT_CRE_RailLift_000_70bb740a-76eb-4255-b607-e2dcad69dbeb, (REAL)_X, (REAL)_Y, (REAL)_Z)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_Place_Wanted("CRE_LiftTop")
AND
GetDistanceTo(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, S_CRE_ElevatorLever_000_893fcb67-a68d-4471-8dd5-28e66f907ae3, _OnBoard)
AND
_OnBoard < 10.0
AND
GetDistanceToPosition(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _X, _Y, _Z, _Dist)
AND
RealDivide(_Dist, 2.0, _Half)
THEN
DB_ALFSV_Lift_Ride(_X, _Y, _Z, _Half);
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Request("CRE_LiftStart");
TimerLaunch("ALFSV_Lift_Poll", 1000);

IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_Lift_Poll")
AND
DB_ALFSV_Lift_Ride(_X, _Y, _Z, _Half)
AND
GetDistanceToPosition(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _X, _Y, _Z, _Dist)
AND
_Dist < _Half
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_Lift_Ride(_X, _Y, _Z, _Half);
DB_ALFSV_Lift_Midway(1);
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Request("CRE_LiftMid");

IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_Lift_Poll")
AND
DB_ALFSV_Lift_Ride(_, _, _, _)
THEN
TimerLaunch("ALFSV_Lift_Poll", 1000);

IF
PlatformMovementFinished(S_LTN_PLT_CRE_RailLift_000_70bb740a-76eb-4255-b607-e2dcad69dbeb, "CRE_Dungeon_ElevatorMoved")
AND
DB_ALFSV_Lift_Midway(1)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_Lift_Midway(1);
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Request("CRE_LiftTop");

// Arrived before the midway poll fired (short ride, reload): no top line without the middle one
IF
PlatformMovementFinished(S_LTN_PLT_CRE_RailLift_000_70bb740a-76eb-4255-b607-e2dcad69dbeb, "CRE_Dungeon_ElevatorMoved")
AND
DB_ALFSV_Lift_Ride(_X, _Y, _Z, _Half)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_Lift_Ride(_X, _Y, _Z, _Half);

//END_REGION

//REGION Clear night: the first free evening in the forest camp (open sky, act 1)
IF
FlagSet(GLO_CAMP_State_NightMode_fb53edc2-9a89-4ad2-af83-20b5fe425cdd, NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, _)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_Place_Wanted("ClearNight")
THEN
DB_ALFSV_ClearNight_Wait(1);
TimerCancel("ALFSV_ClearNight");
TimerLaunch("ALFSV_ClearNight", 5000);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_AvatarInDialog()
AND
DB_Avatars(_Avatar)
AND
DB_InteractiveDialogSpeaker(_, _Avatar)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_ClearNight")
AND
DB_ALFSV_ClearNight_Wait(1)
AND
NOT DB_Camp_NightMode(1)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_ClearNight_Wait(1);

IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_ClearNight")
AND
DB_ALFSV_ClearNight_Wait(1)
AND
DB_ActiveCamp("WLDMAIN")
AND
DB_InCamp(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
NOT DB_Camp_Faded(_, _)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Celebration_Tonight_286ff093-d8b0-584d-9e8d-7c92853e9b5c)
AND
NOT QRY_ALFSV_AvatarInDialog()
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_ClearNight_Wait(1);
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Request("ClearNight");

IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_ClearNight")
AND
DB_ALFSV_ClearNight_Wait(1)
THEN
TimerLaunch("ALFSV_ClearNight", 5000);

//END_REGION

//REGION Travel lines: every 3-6 min while she walks with the party; each line once (flags in the dialog)

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Travel_Start()
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
AND
Random(180000, _Extra)
AND
IntegerSum(180000, _Extra, _Ms)
THEN
TimerCancel("ALFSV_Travel");
TimerLaunch("ALFSV_Travel", _Ms);

IF
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Travel_Start();

IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_Travel")
AND
DB_ALFSV_TravelAD(_Dialog)
AND
DB_Players(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
NOT DB_PlayerInCamp(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_PlacePending(_, _)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_AD_Free()
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_AD_SetMood();
PROC_TryStartAD(_Dialog, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c);

IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_Travel")
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Travel_Start();

IF
AutomatedDialogStarted(_Dialog, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_TravelAD(_Dialog)
THEN
DB_ALFSV_AD_Playing(_Dialog);

// After a place line the next travel line waits a full interval
IF
AutomatedDialogStarted(_Dialog, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Place(_, _Dialog)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Travel_Start();

//END_REGION

//REGION Party banters (design/banter/03_act1_party.md): two speakers over their heads, each once
// Every 20 s look for one; at most one per 5 min; not in combat or a dialog (QRY_SpeakerIsAvailable); road - both in the active party, close; camp - both in camp, a hero passing by

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_Data()
THEN
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B1_2", (DIALOGRESOURCE)CAMP_Bard_AD_Astarion_8072bdb9-de5d-5f1c-a759-c690c4b39cdd, (CHARACTER)S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255, "camp", 2);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B3", (DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_Banter_B3_9951821f-1cbf-5f90-9d2a-8c875c6dee25, (CHARACTER)S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255, "road", 1);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B4", (DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_Banter_B4_ae87a2b3-c6cf-5d94-ac90-04119c6ab16b, (CHARACTER)S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255, "road", 1);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B5", (DIALOGRESOURCE)CAMP_Bard_AD_GaleTressym_283fb1de-0587-991a-58e4-eb7d412b3813, (CHARACTER)S_GLO_Gale_Tressym_ada7ee81-829d-48c7-ba73-9c9ec191d236, "camp", 2);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B6", (DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_Banter_B6_8cfe4117-6d8d-5720-968b-cda8fd4d4e29, (CHARACTER)S_Player_Gale_ad9af97d-75da-406a-ae13-7071c563f604, "road", 1);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B7", (DIALOGRESOURCE)CAMP_Bard_AD_Wyll_e56f19d9-db4c-198d-320d-59175acfe2a3, (CHARACTER)S_Player_Wyll_c774d764-4a17-48dc-b470-32ace9ce447d, "camp", 1);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B8", (DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_Banter_B8_ab6ce15a-5e13-515b-bace-b487f70cec4c, (CHARACTER)S_Player_Wyll_c774d764-4a17-48dc-b470-32ace9ce447d, "road", 1);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B9", (DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_Banter_B9_77e90d8d-7459-5e40-81ba-1ae98f94353e, (CHARACTER)S_Player_ShadowHeart_3ed74f06-3c60-42dc-83f6-f034cb47c679, "road", 1);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B10", (DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_Banter_B10_3f38477e-2ee9-55c8-917e-c9f579df973a, (CHARACTER)S_Player_Laezel_58a69333-40bf-8358-1d17-fff240d7fb12, "road", 1);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B11", (DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_Banter_B11_410b30bb-edf8-51cb-84d8-e191da39b6fb, (CHARACTER)S_Player_Karlach_2c76687d-93a2-477b-8b18-8a14b549304c, "camp", 1);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B12", (DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_Banter_B12_9412b936-4da7-553f-bd50-bd13f9add70a, (CHARACTER)S_Player_Karlach_2c76687d-93a2-477b-8b18-8a14b549304c, "road", 1);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B13", (DIALOGRESOURCE)ALFSV_Banter_B13_71cce9d1-86f3-5257-8b88-67912f7e0e59, (CHARACTER)S_GLO_Halsin_7628bc0e-52b8-42a7-856a-13a6fd413323, "camp", 1);
DB_ALFSV_Banter("B14", (DIALOGRESOURCE)CAMP_Bard_AD_Volo_b5a2ed4f-7bb0-5bb1-bb78-0a2fbaa0d921, (CHARACTER)S_GLO_Volo_2af25a85-5b9a-4794-85d3-0bd4c4d262fa, "camp", 2);

IF
LevelGameplayStarted(_, _)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_Data();
NOT DB_ALFSV_Banter_Cooling(1);
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_StartTick();

IF
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_Data();
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_StartTick();

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_StartTick()
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
TimerCancel("ALFSV_Banter_Tick");
TimerLaunch("ALFSV_Banter_Tick", 20000);

// a request that did not start is forgotten on the next tick
IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_Banter_Tick")
AND
DB_ALFSV_Banter_Requested(_Dialog, _Key)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_Banter_Requested(_Dialog, _Key);

IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_Banter_Tick")
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_Try();
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_StartTick();

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_Try()
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_Banter_Cooling(1)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_AD_Free()
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_PlacePending(_, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Banter(_Key, _Dialog, _Partner, _Where, _Plays)
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_Banter_Requested(_, _)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Left(_Key, _Plays)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok(_Key)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Where(_Where, _Partner)
AND
QRY_SpeakerIsAvailable(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
QRY_SpeakerIsAvailable(_Partner)
AND
IsInCombat(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, 0)
THEN
DB_ALFSV_Banter_Requested(_Dialog, _Key);
PROC_TryStartAD(_Dialog, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Partner);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Left((STRING)_Key, (INTEGER)_Plays)
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_BanterPlayed(_Key, _)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Left((STRING)_Key, (INTEGER)_Plays)
AND
DB_ALFSV_BanterPlayed(_Key, _N)
AND
_N < _Plays
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Where("road", (CHARACTER)_Partner)
AND
DB_Players(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
DB_Players(_Partner)
AND
NOT DB_InCamp(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
GetDistanceTo(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Partner, _Dist)
AND
_Dist < 10.0
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Where("camp", (CHARACTER)_Partner)
AND
DB_InCamp(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
GetDistanceTo(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Partner, _Dist)
AND
_Dist < 20.0
AND
DB_Avatars(_Avatar)
AND
GetDistanceTo(_Avatar, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Near)
AND
_Near < 10.0
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B1_2")
AND
DB_PartOfTheTeam(S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B3")
AND
DB_ALFSV_BanterPlayed("B1_2", _After)
AND
_After >= 2
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B4")
AND
DB_Avatars(_Avatar)
AND
GetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Romance_Started_1fa672d6-9d12-5018-9492-6af2b7ed484b, _Avatar, 1)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B5")
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B6")
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B7")
AND
DB_PartOfTheTeam(S_Player_Wyll_c774d764-4a17-48dc-b470-32ace9ce447d)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B8")
AND
DB_ALFSV_BanterPlayed("B7", _After)
AND
_After >= 1
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B9")
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B10")
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B11")
AND
DB_PartOfTheTeam(S_Player_Karlach_2c76687d-93a2-477b-8b18-8a14b549304c)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B12")
AND
DB_Avatars(_Avatar)
AND
GetFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Elturel_AngrySong_d430ee4b-dbe8-52de-b96f-14d198609aa7, _Avatar, 1)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B13")
AND
DB_PartOfTheTeam(S_GLO_Halsin_7628bc0e-52b8-42a7-856a-13a6fd413323)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Banter_Ok("B14")
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

// started: count it, cool down
IF
AutomatedDialogStarted(_Dialog, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Banter_Requested(_Dialog, _Key)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_Banter_Requested(_Dialog, _Key);
DB_ALFSV_AD_Playing(_Dialog);
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_Played(_Key);
DB_ALFSV_Banter_Cooling(1);
TimerCancel("ALFSV_Banter_Cooldown");
TimerLaunch("ALFSV_Banter_Cooldown", 300000);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_Played((STRING)_Key)
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_BanterPlayed(_Key, _)
THEN
DB_ALFSV_BanterPlayed(_Key, 0);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Banter_Played((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_BanterPlayed(_Key, _N)
AND
IntegerSum(_N, 1, _Next)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_BanterPlayed(_Key, _N);
DB_ALFSV_BanterPlayed(_Key, _Next);

IF
TimerFinished("ALFSV_Banter_Cooldown")
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_Banter_Cooling(1);

// Debug (Script Extender console): Osi.PROC_ALFSV_Debug_Banter("B3") - the banter now (ignores count and cooldown)
PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_Banter((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_BanterPlayed(_Key, _N)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_BanterPlayed(_Key, _N);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_Banter((STRING)_Key)
AND
DB_ALFSV_Banter(_Key, _Dialog, _Partner, _, _)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_Banter_Cooling(1);
DB_ALFSV_Banter_Requested(_Dialog, _Key);
PROC_TryStartAD(_Dialog, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Partner);

// Lakrissa dead: the game has no flag (DB_Dead, as Act3b_LOW_ElfsongTavern.txt checks it)
IF
DB_Dead(S_DEN_Tiefling_010_23129d6c-8d39-4a4c-a4f6-cfc6637b597c)
THEN
PROC_GlobalSetFlagAndCache((FLAG)ALFSV_LakrissaDead_dae7049c-6d02-561d-8c6f-d615e6657603);

//END_REGION

//REGION Debug (Script Extender console)
// Osi.PROC_ALFSV_Debug_Place("CRE_LiftMid") - play a place line now (ignores 'done')

THEN

THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Request(_Key);

PROC

THEN
TimerCancel("ALFSV_Travel");
TimerLaunch("ALFSV_Travel", 5000);
